title: certis: artifact for When Does Band Retrieval Pay? Scope, Density, and a Measured Floor for Retroactive Rule Evaluation
description:
Scripts, stored runs and an assertion file behind every number in the paper. reproduce.py re-derives the host-free values and compares them against expected.json, exiting non-zero on any mismatch; timings are printed and not asserted. The corpus-dependent steps download 27 published CMS release files and verify each by SHA-256.

The CMS tables themselves are not redistributed: the PTP and MUE quarterly files carry CPT content that is American Medical Association property.
